title: SMS AI Ghana: pilot
description: Plan §13 metrics for the single-VM pilot.

panels.title: Inbound (24 h)
panels.description: Inbound SMS messages plus USSD steps in the last 24 hours.

targets.expr: sum(((channel_inbound_total unless channel_inbound_total offset 24h) or increase(channel_inbound_total[24h]))) or vector(0)

panels.title: USSD answered inline (24 h)
panels.description: Share of USSD questions answered inside the session (no SMS cost), versus by MT SMS after the fast-path deadline.

targets.expr: sum(((ussd_inline_delivery_total unless ussd_inline_delivery_total offset 24h) or increase(ussd_inline_delivery_total[24h]))) / (sum(((ussd_inline_delivery_total unless ussd_inline_delivery_total offset 24h) or increase(ussd_inline_delivery_total[24h]))) + sum(((ussd_async_sms_fallback_total unless ussd_async_sms_fallback_total offset 24h) or increase(ussd_async_sms_fallback_total[24h]))))

panels.title: Spend today / daily cap
panels.description: Estimated spend (SMS segments + AI tokens) as a share of GLOBAL_DAILY_SPEND_CAP_USD, from the worker. AI answers stop at 100%; the day resets at 00:00 UTC.

panels.title: Empty AI responses (24 h)
panels.description: Reasoning-model calls that returned no visible text. Must stay 0 (plan §7.2).

targets.expr: sum(((ai_empty_reasoning_response_total unless ai_empty_reasoning_response_total offset 24h) or increase(ai_empty_reasoning_response_total[24h]))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Unknown-outcome sends (24 h)
panels.description: SMS submissions the provider did not confirm in time. They are never resent automatically; see docs/RUNBOOKS.md.

panels.title: Last backup
panels.description: Time since the last successful nightly pg_dump.

panels.title: Inbound per minute by channel
panels.description: channel_inbound_total: SMS messages and USSD steps.

panels.title: Inbound per minute by network
panels.description: channel_inbound_total by carrier (from the number prefix).

panels.title: USSD: inline answer vs SMS fallback (per hour)
panels.description: Inline answers cost no SMS; fallbacks are answered by MT SMS after USSD_FAST_PATH_TIMEOUT_MS.

panels.title: Grounding store hits vs misses (per hour)
panels.description: Direct answers from the Local Ghana Grounding Store (0 tokens) versus questions sent to the model.

panels.title: Coalescing, MORE, duplicates, limits (per hour)
panels.description: Merged multipart texts, MORE pages served from the buffer, ignored duplicate webhooks, and questions refused by the per-number daily cap.

targets.expr: sum(((daily_limit_reached_total unless daily_limit_reached_total offset 1h) or increase(daily_limit_reached_total[1h])))

panels.title: Submitted per hour by encoding
panels.description: MT SMS accepted by the provider. UCS-2 costs up to 3x the segments of GSM-7.

targets.expr: sum by (encoding) (((sms_outbound_submitted_total unless sms_outbound_submitted_total offset 1h) or increase(sms_outbound_submitted_total[1h])))

panels.title: Submitted per hour by segment count
panels.description: Answers should fit one segment; MORE carries the rest.

targets.expr: sum by (segments) (((sms_outbound_submitted_total unless sms_outbound_submitted_total offset 1h) or increase(sms_outbound_submitted_total[1h])))

panels.title: Failed or blocked sends per hour by reason
panels.description: unknown_timeout needs an operator (RUNBOOKS.md); blocked_cap and blocked_disabled come from the cap and the kill switch.

targets.expr: sum by (provider, reason) (((sms_outbound_failed_total unless sms_outbound_failed_total offset 1h) or increase(sms_outbound_failed_total[1h])))

panels.title: Model calls per minute by outcome
panels.description: ai_requests_total from both the api (USSD fast path) and the worker.

panels.title: Model latency (p50 / p95 / p99)
panels.description: The dashed line is the 3.2 s USSD fast-path deadline.

panels.title: Empty reasoning responses
panels.description: Must stay 0. Any bar here also raises the AIEmptyReasoningResponse alert.

targets.expr: sum by (model) (((ai_empty_reasoning_response_total unless ai_empty_reasoning_response_total offset 15m) or increase(ai_empty_reasoning_response_total[15m])))

panels.title: Spend today vs daily cap (USD)
panels.description: From the worker, refreshed every minute. The day resets at 00:00 UTC.

panels.title: Voucher credits redeemed (per hour)
panels.description: Bonus credits granted by sponsored voucher pools.

panels.title: Rejected webhooks per 10 min
panels.description: Signature or payload failures, by provider and reason.

targets.expr: sum by (provider, reason) (((webhook_rejected_total unless webhook_rejected_total offset 10m) or increase(webhook_rejected_total[10m])))

panels.title: Jobs per hour by kind and result
panels.description: failed and send_failed raise the JobsFailing alert. ai_unavailable comes from a kill switch, the spend cap or the AI breaker.

targets.expr: sum by (kind, result) (((jobs_processed_total unless jobs_processed_total offset 1h) or increase(jobs_processed_total[1h])))

panels.title: Scrape targets up
panels.description: up: 1 when Prometheus can scrape the target.

panels.title: Firing alerts
panels.description: Alerts Prometheus is firing now. Silence them in Alerting > Silences (Alertmanager data source).

panels.title: Free disk space on the VM
panels.description: Postgres, dumps, Prometheus and logs share this disk. Alerts at 15% and 5%.

panels.title: Backup size
panels.description: Size of the latest successful nightly dump. A sudden drop deserves a look.
